name: My9Swallows TOPSTARS LEAGUE
source:
This is a collaboration between Otomate and Tokyo Yakult Swallows!

WE ARE GROWING UP!
The match (game) of the players (idols) is about to begin——! 

On the protagonist's first day after joining Yakult Baseball Team, a new professional baseball league called the "Top Stars League" is announced.
To participate in the Top Stars League, players must not only compete in baseball games but also in singing and dancing—meaning they need baseball players who can sing and dance!
Meanwhile Yakult Baseball Club will also participate in the Top Stars League... 
The protagonist, who has just joined the company, is now in charge of management!?
translation:
本作由Otomate与东京养乐多燕子队合作推出！

我们正在成长！
选手（偶像）们的比赛（游戏）即将开始——！

主角加入养乐多棒球队后的第一天，联赛宣布创办名为“Top Stars League”的全新职业棒球联盟。
若想参加Top Stars League，选手不仅要打棒球，还得唱歌跳舞——也就是说，他们需要会唱歌跳舞的棒球选手！
与此同时，养乐多棒球俱乐部也将参加Top Stars League……
刚加入公司的主角，现在竟然要负责管理工作！？
